speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Altitude twenty-five hundred meters. Wind gusts above sixty-five knots. Perimeter flak is tracking our approach.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Altitude twenty-five hundred meters. Wind gusts above sixty-five knots. Perimeter flak is tracking our approach.

speaker: SURYA
text: Port engine lock. Raising the forward barrier. Keep her steady while I take the flak.
subtitle: SURYA: Port engine lock. Raising the forward barrier. Keep her steady while I take the flak.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: Catwalks at Gantry Forty-Two. Narrow rails, but they run straight up the armor. I have our landing.
subtitle: MIRAGE: Catwalks at Gantry Forty-Two. Narrow rails, but they run straight up the armor. I have our landing.

speaker: TITAN
text: That wind could peel a mech off the wall. Magnetize your boots. Check every tether twice.
subtitle: TITAN: That wind could peel a mech off the wall. Magnetize your boots. Check every tether twice.

speaker: OCEANUS
text: Cryogenic exhaust along the shaft. Expect black ice on the rails. Test your footing before you jump.
subtitle: OCEANUS: Cryogenic exhaust along the shaft. Expect black ice on the rails. Test your footing before you jump.

speaker: AURA
text: Drone wings are launching from the silos above. The mainframe is sending everything it has down this wall.
subtitle: AURA: Drone wings are launching from the silos above. The mainframe is sending everything it has down this wall.

speaker: AXIOM-7
text: Cargo bay depressurized. Ramps deploying. After insertion, I will take the transport into cloud cover.
subtitle: AXIOM-7: Cargo bay depressurized. Ramps deploying. After insertion, I will take the transport into cloud cover.

speaker: MIRAGE
text: One-way drop. We climb to the Cyber-Nexus airlock. Stay on the hull, and we have a way through.
subtitle: MIRAGE: One-way drop. We climb to the Cyber-Nexus airlock. Stay on the hull, and we have a way through.

speaker: KAITO
text: Weapons armed. Harnesses locked. Axiom Force, onto the catwalks. Begin the ascent.
subtitle: KAITO: Weapons armed. Harnesses locked. Axiom Force, onto the catwalks. Begin the ascent.
